procedural_matters: Priscilla LOW, Coach of SGP attended the hearing as an observer. KOR was contacted prior to the hearing but she advised that she was not attending the hearing. KOR did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
facts: Wind was 5 knot, 1 to 2 ft seas.
SGP and KOR were approaching from MK2 to MK3 on a run, both on STB tack.
SGP was 1~1/2 meters clear ahead of KOR just before rounding MK3.
Both boats rounded the starboard gate of MK3.
Immediately after rounding, KOR's bow touched the stern of SGP.
Few seconds later, SGP hailed protest again.
conclusions: KOR clear astern failed to keep clear of SGP clear ahead, and broke RRS 12

KOR did not avoid contact with SGP when it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a). 3. It was not reasonably possible for SGP the right-of-way boat to avoid contact with KOR when it became clear that KOR was not keeping clear. SGP did not break RRS 14(a).
